name: Donghe
registryBasis: Baotou municipal government materials identify Donghe as one of the city’s urban districts. The municipal Real Estate Registration Center report lists a Donghe receiving sub-center, establishing a local registration service. This supports local registry presence; the roster point is treated as the WUP settlement point, not a legal-boundary determination.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The official material establishes registration service, but no anonymous public parcel-feature route or safe geometry-and-ID schema was verified. No map/property query was made.
scopeLimits: The city registration center and Donghe sub-center are documented; no parcel coverage or exact boundary at the WUP point is asserted.
remainingUncertainty: A legally authoritative boundary overlay was not used to independently test the WUP centroid against Donghe district limits.
